elements.name: Adze of Annam
elements.desc:
Weapon (greataxe), artifact (requires attunement)

This massive adze is said to have been wielded by All-Father Annam, not as a weapon but as the tool he used to shape the various worlds of the Material Plane eons ago. It functions as a +3 greataxe.

**Random Properties.** The artifact has the following random properties:
- 2 minor beneficial properties
- 1 major beneficial property
- 1 minor detrimental property

**World-Shaping.** You can use an action to strike the ground with the adze, casting the Move Earth spell from it. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

**Forge of Creation.** You can use the adze to cast the Fabricate spell at will, shaping raw materials into finished goods.

**Destroying the Adze.** The adze can be destroyed if it is used to strike the heart of a primordial earth elemental on the Elemental Plane of Earth.

elements.name: Bloodshed Blade
elements.desc:
Weapon (any sword), rare (requires attunement)

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with it, you can choose to take 1d6 necrotic damage. If you do, the target takes an extra 2d6 necrotic damage.

elements.name: Longbow of the Healing Hearth
elements.desc:
Weapon (longbow), very rare (requires attunement)

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with it, you can choose to deal no damage and instead restore 2d8 + 2 hit points to the target. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

elements.name: Prehistoric Figurine of Wondrous Power
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, rarity varies

These figurines are carved from bone or stone and depict prehistoric beasts. If you use an action to speak the command word and throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of you, the figurine becomes a living creature. The creature is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands. The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form.

**Types.**
- **Mammoth (Rare).** Can become a mammoth for up to 8 hours. Once used, can't be used again until 5 days have passed.
- **Saber-Toothed Tiger (Uncommon).** Can become a saber-toothed tiger for up to 4 hours. Once used, can't be used again until 3 days have passed.
- **Woolly Rhinoceros (Rare).** Can become a woolly rhinoceros for up to 6 hours. Once used, can't be used again until 4 days have passed.

elements.name: Lucent Destroyer
elements.desc:
Weapon (any firearm), very rare (requires attunement)

This magic firearm is crafted from a strange, golden-hued metal and set with a large, glowing gem. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. When you hit with it, the target takes an extra 2d6 radiant damage. If the target is a fiend or undead, it takes an extra 2d6 radiant damage instead.

elements.name: Thunderbuss
elements.desc:
Weapon (any firearm), rare

This magic firearm deals an extra 1d6 thunder damage on a hit. When you fire it, it emits a thunderous boom that can be heard up to 300 feet away.

elements.name: Gauntlets of Rune-Carved Might
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement)

These heavy gauntlets are inscribed with giant runes. While wearing them, your unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d6 force damage on a hit. As an action, you can invoke the runes to cast the Thunderwave spell (save DC 15) from the gauntlets. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

elements.name: Orb of Skoraeus
elements.desc:
Wondrous item, artifact (requires attunement)

This smooth, stone orb is carved with runes that pulse with a faint inner light. It functions as a spellcasting focus.

**Random Properties.** The artifact has the following random properties:
- 2 minor beneficial properties
- 1 major beneficial property
- 1 minor detrimental property

**Spells.** The orb has 6 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 18): Stone Shape (2 charges), Wall of Stone (3 charges), or Move Earth (4 charges). It regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn.

**Petrifying Gaze.** As an action, you can target one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 18). On a failed save, the target is restrained as its flesh begins to harden. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the target is petrified for 1 hour. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

elements.name: Wand of the Great Magister
elements.desc:
Wand, artifact (requires attunement by a spellcaster)

This wand is carved from the heartwood of the World Tree and tipped with a crystal that holds the essence of a storm giant's magic.

**Random Properties.** The artifact has the following random properties:
- 2 minor beneficial properties
- 1 major beneficial property
- 1 minor detrimental property

**Spells.** The wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 18): Lightning Bolt (3 charges), Chain Lightning (6 charges), or Control Weather (7 charges). It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.

**Storm Aura.** While holding the wand, you can use an action to surround yourself with a 15-foot-radius aura of stormy wind for 1 minute. While the aura is active, you have resistance to lightning and thunder damage, and any creature that starts its turn in the aura takes 2d6 lightning damage.
